quotes.text: Open Banking do not provide direct access to live API end points. Rather, these are implemented and supported by each API provider. The API Dashboard lists all available API end points, and show which API version is supported by each provider.
Enrolment is optional for API users but is required if you wish to receive support from Open Banking. API Providers must enrol.
Providers adopting Open Banking maintain control of their information, ensuring their products are accurately represented.
